forProfessionals.title: For Professionals
forProfessionals.mainMessage: We're not selling you more work. We're giving you the power to choose better.
forProfessionals.pain2: Jobs far away that don't pay off?
forProfessionals.solution: With Specialist, you browse posted jobs and decide which ones to take.

benefit1.title: Choose your zone
benefit1.desc: Filter jobs near you. No more wasted trips.

benefit2.title: All info before accepting
benefit2.desc: Photos of the problem, clear description, exact location. You know what you're getting into.

benefit3.title: Rated clients
benefit3.desc: Check the client's score. Avoid the troublemakers.

benefit4.title: No obligations
benefit4.desc: We don't assign you anything. You choose what, when, and where.

forClients.title: For Clients
forClients.mainMessage: Post your job and let professionals contact you

benefit1.title: Post in minutes

benefit2.desc: Profiles with real ratings from other clients.

benefit3.title: You choose
benefit3.desc: Receive proposals and pick the one that suits you best.

howItWorks.title: How it works?
howItWorks.proStep1Desc: Create your profile with your trades and work zones.
howItWorks.proStep2Desc: Check out requests posted by clients in your area.
howItWorks.proStep3Desc: If interested, contact the client. If not, move on.
